```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(Rilostat)

library(ggplot2)
```

# Part 1: Importing data with R packages

## Female labour force participation (ILO)

**1.** 
We selected “Labour force participation rate by sex and age” (`EAP_DWAP_SEX_AGE_RT_A`). It measures the labour force as a percentage of the population in the corresponding sex and age group. We focus on women aged 45–54. Among the matching annual series in the ILOSTAT catalogue, this dataset has the earliest starting year (1946), whereas the ILO modelled series starts in 1990.

**2.**
```{r}
library(Rilostat)

# Search for labour force participation datasets
toc <- get_ilostat_toc(
  search = "Labour force participation",
  quiet = TRUE
)

# Compare the annual series by sex and age
toc[
  toc$id %in% c(
    "EAP_DWAP_SEX_AGE_RT_A",
    "EAP_2WAP_SEX_AGE_RT_A",
    "EAP_5WAP_SEX_AGE_RT_A"
  ),
  c("id", "data.start", "data.end")
]
```

```{r}
# Import data for women aged 45–54, for all countries
df_ilo <- get_ilostat(
  id = "EAP_DWAP_SEX_AGE_RT_A",
  type = "code",
  time_format = "num",
  filters = list(
    sex = "SEX_F",
    classif1 = "AGE_10YRBANDS_Y45-54",
    timefrom = 1950,
    timeto = 2025
  ),
  best_source = "all",
  quiet = TRUE
)

# Check the available years
min(df_ilo$time)
max(df_ilo$time)
```
